title: not near as thin as I had hoped
text:
not near as thin as I had hoped. We got away from those cheap fat plastic hangers years ago after finding some nice tink sturdy hangers. I thought we needed more hangers so I ordered these. Honestly they are not much thinner than the old cheap ones that we used to use.

These are decent quality, but if you are looking for slim hangers, I would suggest you keep on looking.

Sorry, these are OK but not exactly what I had expected.
